description: This file defines a helper class 'FrameHelper' that manages JFrame windows for a Swing-based GUI, including initializing, displaying, and handling window events. It also logs window open/close events via the FileLog utility.

classes.name: FrameHelper
classes.description: A utility class to simplify displaying and managing JFrame windows in a Swing GUI application.

methods.name: getFrame
methods.description: Returns the JFrame instance managed by this helper.

methods.name: showFrame
methods.description: Displays the specified JComponent in a JFrame, with optional maximization on start.

methods.name: showFrame (overload)
methods.description: Displays the component with an option to maximize on launch.

methods.name: initFrame
methods.description: Initializes the JFrame, sets size, default close operation, adds window listeners, and adds the component.

methods.name: onWindowClosed
methods.description: Logs the window closed event and closes the log.

methods.name: getDefaultFontSize
methods.description: Returns the default font size of the window.
